Starting Desperation1
Starting Danger0 of 5

A small cell, with a tight budget and a clear order: confirm whether Seattle has “an organized structure” and, if it does, don't touch it until it can be torn out by the roots. Special Agent Dana Okafor runs it from an eleventh-floor office in South Lake Union. It has one analyst who doesn't sleep, two more analysts, six operators contracted as a counterterrorism unit, and a liaison with the FBI's Seattle field office.
system.privatenotes:
Starting Desperation 1: a single cell, a budget that doesn't stretch far enough, and a source nobody trusts. Starting Danger 0: the quarry doesn't know the Cell exists. See @UUID[JournalEntry.dnsWkdXVJ19riBLa.JournalEntryPage.O8yPSIYLlTrKHm8G]{The Puget Cell} for how they rise and fall during the adventure.

Proposed (not in the docs)

  • Starting Desperation 1 and starting Danger 0 (maximum 5), and the rules for moving them during the adventure (page CEL-01).
  • The motto sums up the order doc 14 gives Okafor.
